name: opus-delegate
description: Delegate substantial implementation, debugging, or independent review from Codex to Claude Opus through reliable headless wrappers, so the calling model spends fewer tokens without giving up solution quality.

interface.shortDescription: Hand bounded work to Claude Opus from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Worker and consultant wrappers that run Claude Opus headlessly on a bounded task, plus the policy for deciding when delegating is actually cheaper than doing the work locally.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $opus-delegate to hand this refactor to Opus and report back with verification evidence.
